name: HCL Technologies Limited
remarksWeb: Notes for details of Significant Beneficial Owner :   1. Mr. Shiv Nadar (SBO ID-SB00038683) holds majority stake i.e. 51% in Vama Sundari Investments (Delhi) Private Limited. Accordingly his proportionate shareholding in HCL Technologies Limited ('Company') comes to 22.525%. The balance 49% share in Vama Sundari Investments (Delhi) Private Limited are held by other family members (Mrs. Kiran Nadar- Spouse, Mrs. Roshni Nadar Malhotra- Daughter and Mr. Shikhar Neelkamal Malhotra- Son-in-law). Accordingly, the aggregate shareholding of Mr. Shiv Nadar along with his family members in the Company is 44.167%.   2. Mr. Shiv Nadar (SBO ID-SB00038683 ) holds majority stake i.e. 51% in HCL Corporation Private Limited. Accordingly his proportionate shareholding in HCL Technologies Limited ('Company') comes to 0.0867%. The balance 49% share in HCL Corporation Private Limited are held by other family members (Mrs. Kiran Nadar, Mrs. Roshni Nadar Malhotra- Daughter and Mr. Shikhar Neelkamal Malhotra- Son-in-law). Accordingly, the aggregate shareholding of Mr. Shiv Nadar along with his family members in the Company is 0.17%.   3. HCL Holdings Private Limited holds 16.46% equity shares in HCL Technologies Limited. The shareholding in HCL Holdings Private Limited is held through Vama Sundari Trust. Since, it is a discretionary trust, interest of none of the beneficiaries has materialized or crystallized as on the date of this disclosure and, as a consequence, cannot be determined. The Settlor of this Trust is Mrs. Roshni Nadar Malhotra.

name: HCL Technologies Limited
revisionRemark: This is with reference to the auto generated e-mail received from NEAPS on ��April 12, 2023, requesting us to revise the shareholding patterns of the Company for the quarters ended Sep 30., 2022 and Dec. 31, 2022 respectively.  In this regard, we would like to inform you that we have vide our letter dated March 15, 2023 submitted our responses to your queries in this regard, and thereafter explained the same over a call to the concerned officials in the NSE.  We would like to reiterate that in��our case, the shareholding of ��Kiran Nadar Museum of Art PAN AABTK5896P), Promoter Group (��KNMA��) had become NIL in the previous quarter i.e. quarter ended September 30, 2022. Accordingly, we had shown the name with NIL holding in the shareholding pattern of September quarter. ��As there was no holding of the aforesaid shareholder in the quarter ended December 31, 2022 as well, the name was removed from the shareholding pattern of this quarter which is a subsequent quarter.  The above action was taken in accordance with the guidance given the FAQs issued by the NSE dated December 14, 2022 with respect to submission of shareholding pattern. The FAQ states that where the Promoter holding become NIL as the shares are sold/transferred, the name should not be removed during that quarter. Complying with the same, the name was not removed during that quarter i.e. quarter ending Sep., 2022 in which the shares were sold/transferred, and the shareholding was shown as NIL. It was only in the subsequent quarter that the name was removed.  A similar observation was given by BSE as well and basis our above submission the same has been accepted.  We would request to consider and accept the same. We would be pleased to have a call with you to provide any further clarification that you may need.

name: HCL Technologies Limited
remarksWeb: 1. HCL Holdings Private Limited holds 16.47% equity shares in HCL Technologies Limited. The shareholding in HCL Holdings Private Limited is held through Vama Sundari Trust. Since it is a discretionary trust, interest of none of the beneficiaries has materialized or crystallized as on the date of this disclosure and, as a consequence, cannot be determined. The Settlor of this Trust is Ms. Roshni Nadar Malhotra. 2. HCL Healthcare Private Limited is owned by Slocum Healthcare Private Limited which is 100 % Owned by Vamasundari Investments (Delhi) Private Limited. Therefore, Ultimate Parent Company of HCL Healthcare Private Limited is Vamasundari Investments (Delhi) Private Limited. So, Vamasundari Investments (Delhi) Private Limited indirectly holds 92.7 % shares in HCL Avitas Pvt Ltd.
